findings: The GIO backend module and juniorosa declaration map without treating remote juniocr26 as import authority.
SQLx reflectx, SDK backoff and Prometheus labels map to existing pinned same-module directories.
Chi example and SDK nested otel source imports of their repository root module safely refuse as cross-module.
Four module-root queries find regular Go source; GIO backend root has no Go files and safely refuses despite containing go.mod.
This proves bounded pinned-tree directory existence, not that any file set is a buildable package or that an imported identifier binds correctly.
initial_harness_failure: The initial experiment harness incorrectly expected every module-root query to map. The diagnostic correctly refused GIO backend because no regular Go file exists at that root. Initial script/log retained; no resolver code or production change was needed.
integration_decision: Keep private diagnostic only. No production resolver or retrieval tool introduced. A future separately scoped design must address excluded semantics before use.
